meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Select aggregates of all scheduled commercial banks and of all scheduled banks, every reporting fortnight, with the series excluding the HDFC merger
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 901 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Final figures where published, else provisional. Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (All scheduled banks, Borrowings from Reserve Bank on 2004-02-20; All scheduled banks, Borrowings from Reserve Bank on 2005-08-19; All scheduled banks, Borrowings from Reserve Bank on 2005-11-11).
